# Grafloria

> The framework-agnostic diagram engine. Flow charts, dashboards, UML, ERD, and real-time
> collaboration — one headless TypeScript core with native bindings for Angular, React, Vue,
> and a plain web component. MIT licensed, every feature free; there is no commercial tier.

Grafloria ships what other diagram libraries sell or leave to DIY: obstacle-avoiding
orthogonal edge routing (never crosses its own nodes), built-in auto-layout (ELK layered,
tree, force — off-thread in a Worker), command-based undo/redo, minimap/snap/marquee editor
chrome, per-property CRDT collaboration with live cursors and anchored comments, keyboard
accessibility with live-region narration, server-side SVG/PNG/PDF export, a Mermaid-compatible
text format that round-trips through the live canvas, a drag-and-pack dashboard kit, and
interactive UML/ER kits. Every capability is demonstrated by one of 100+ live demos, each
executed in CI with real pointer events.

## Packages (npm, all MIT)

- @grafloria/engine — headless diagram model: nodes, edges, ports, groups, layout, CRDT collab. Runs in Node, workers, browsers; no DOM required.
- @grafloria/renderer — SVG renderer over the engine: interaction, routing, editor chrome, export, comments UI.
- @grafloria/angular — Angular components: <grafloria-diagram-canvas> with [(nodes)]/[(edges)] two-way bindings, ng-template custom nodes, [layout], [plugins], [collab], [comments].
- @grafloria/react — React components & hooks: <GrafloriaFlow>, nodeTypes, useGrafloria/useSelection/useViewport, <GrafloriaCommentPanel>.
- @grafloria/vue — Vue 3 components & composables: <GrafloriaFlow> with v-model:nodes, #node-<type> slots, provider composables.
- @grafloria/element — dependency-free custom element <grafloria-flow>; also renders kit specs (erDiagram, umlDiagram, dashboard) and Mermaid-style text.

## Quick start (plain web)

Two doors. The function (spec FIRST, target second; spec is data, not Mermaid text):

```js
import { render } from '@grafloria/element';

const api = render({
  nodes: [
    { id: 'a', position: { x: 40, y: 60 },  size: { width: 160, height: 60 }, label: 'Start' },
    { id: 'b', position: { x: 260, y: 60 }, size: { width: 160, height: 60 }, label: 'Ship' },
  ],
  edges: [{ id: 'e1', source: 'a', target: 'b' }],
}, document.getElementById('canvas'));   // the target MUST have a real height
```

Or the custom element — JSON attributes in, bubbling `grafloria-*` DOM events out;
properties `el.nodes = [...]` / `el.edges` work after mount, and `el.diagram` is the
full instance. There is NO `el.render()` method and NO top-level `x`/`y` on nodes —
node geometry is always `position: { x, y }` (+ optional `size: { width, height }`):

```html
<script type="module">import '@grafloria/element';</script>
<grafloria-flow theme="light" fit-view style="height: 80vh"
  nodes='[{"id":"a","position":{"x":0,"y":0},"label":"Extract"},
          {"id":"b","position":{"x":220,"y":0},"label":"Load"}]'
  edges='[{"source":"a","target":"b"}]'>
</grafloria-flow>
```

## Quick start (React)

```tsx
import { GrafloriaFlow } from '@grafloria/react';

<GrafloriaFlow
  nodes={nodes}
  edges={edges}
  onNodesChange={setNodes}
  layout="elk"
  plugins
/>
```

## Docs

- [Learn](https://grafloria.com/learn/): 10-minute tutorials (JavaScript, React, Vue, Angular) + nine concept guides (model, ports & validation, commands & undo, layout, Mermaid & the text format, theming, export, collaboration, kits). Every sample executed against the published packages. Full text: https://grafloria.com/llms-full.txt
- [Live demo gallery](https://grafloria.com/demos/): 100+ runnable pages — view-source is the tutorial; every demo is also a CI test.
- [How Grafloria compares](https://grafloria.com/compare/): three sourced matrices — vs diagram libraries (React Flow, JointJS+, GoJS, ngx-vflow), vs dashboard grids (GridStack.js, react-grid-layout, angular-gridster2, Muuri), and vs Mermaid.
- Framework guides: [React & Next.js](https://grafloria.com/react/), [Angular](https://grafloria.com/angular/), [Vue 3](https://grafloria.com/vue/), [plain JavaScript](https://grafloria.com/javascript/) — per-framework install, idiomatic quickstart, and links to that framework's demo variants.
- [Mermaid support](https://grafloria.com/mermaid/): which Mermaid types Grafloria reads and writes (flowchart, erDiagram, classDiagram, stateDiagram), the three-tier extension model, the round trip, and the named gaps.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/grafloria/grafloria): source, READMEs per package, issues.
- [npm organization](https://www.npmjs.com/org/grafloria): published packages.

## Notes for code generation

- Node geometry: `position: { x, y }` (required) and `size: { width, height }` — never top-level x/y.
- Custom HTML nodes need `custom: true` on the spec in plain JS and React (`nodeTypes`); Vue slots (`#node-<type>`) and Angular templates (`ng-template grafloriaNode="type"`) flag it automatically.
- Undo/redo live on the ENGINE, not the instance: `instance.getEngine().undo()` (async). ⌘Z/Ctrl+Z works with zero wiring. Angular's canvas component mirrors undo()/redo() directly.
- React useNodesState returns [nodes, setNodes, onNodesChange] — wire the THIRD element into <GrafloriaFlow onNodesChange>, not setNodes.
- The canvas fills its container: the parent element must have a real height or the page renders blank.
- Connection validators (registerConnectionValidator from @grafloria/element) are process-global — keep the disposer and clear on unmount.
- Versions ≥ engine 0.3.1 / renderer 0.4.1 / element 0.4.0 are pure ESM; shipped weight is ~230–450 KB gz eager with ELK layout in a lazy chunk (see each package README's "Bundle size" section for the reproduction script).

- Ports are model anatomy (spec.ports on a node), not separate components — identical across all frameworks.
- The same JSON spec drives every surface; there is no framework-specific model.
- Collab: pass collab={{ transport, actor, presence: true }} — the CRDT lives in the engine; BroadcastChannel works serverless for same-browser tabs.
- Text format: importDiagramText() / exportDiagramText() round-trip Mermaid text with a lossless %%grafloria:document position sidecar; the visible body stays valid Mermaid. Supported types: flowchart/graph, erDiagram, classDiagram, stateDiagram[-v2]. Every other type returns { unsupported: '<type>' } rather than a wrong diagram — check that field before rendering.
- Dashboard CONTAINERS: a widget spec carrying `widgets` (plus optional `columns`, `maxRows`) nests a board inside a board — cross-boundary drag, one-undo gestures, escalation, nested toJSON() all included (element >= 0.4.2).
- Dashboards / UML / ER: kits are FUNCTIONS — call erDiagram({ entities, relationships }) / umlDiagram({ classes, relationships }) / dashboard({ widgets }) from @grafloria/element and pass the RETURNED spec to render(spec, host) or <GrafloriaDiagram :spec>. There is no { erDiagram: ... } wrapper-object form.
